reasoning_evidence: Reported 2027-12-15 is the contractually scheduled Commercial Operation Date in signed IA Amendment 1 (sources/2026-07-18_puct_35077-1807_centerpoint-nrg-cedar-bayou-5-IA-amend1.pdf Exhibit B ¶4) — grounded in a countersigned document, not merely a queue-report claim

Amendment 1 (signed Apr 2024) already slipped Scheduled COD from original IA's 'later of 2025-06-01 or +6mo after ISD' (sources/2026-07-18_puct_35077-1362_centerpoint-nrg-cedar-bayou-5-IA.pdf) to 2027-12-15 — ~2.5 yr pre-construction slip; queue history shows 4 COD changes 2023-07 → 2027-12 (timeline.md), a project pattern of drift

TIF ISD is later of 2027-07-14 or +38mo after prerequisites (Amend 1 Exhibit B ¶3), leaving ≤5 months slack to the 2027-12-15 COD — thin buffer for a 1×1 M501JAC CCGT that typically requires 28-34 months mobilization-to-COD even on brownfield sites

No mobilization visible in 2026-07 imagery; 29 months to reported COD from a no-activity start is achievable for a brownfield 1×1 CCGT if EPC mobilizes in H2 2026, but any further schedule slip (e.g., TEF financial close pushes into 2027, Mitsubishi delivery delay) trims that headroom to zero

Positive credibility signals: (a) PUCT TEF Staff advanced NRG APP-016 to due-diligence 2024-12-12 (sources/2026-07-18_puct_56896-60_cedar-bayou-DD-memo.pdf) requiring signed EPC + equity attestation + equipment arrangements; (b) CB5 did NOT file for schedule extension in PUCT 56896 while ~10 sibling TEF applicants (Greens Bayou 6, Bulldog, Homestead, Pecos, Permian I/II, etc.) did; (c) LC nearly doubled from $4.9M to $9.4M with Amendment 1; (d) NRG contractually committed to Mitsubishi M501JAC by signature Apr 2024 (Amend 1 Exhibit C ¶5); (e) TCEQ RE RN110333184 registered as distinct entity for the expansion consistent with active NSR permitting; (f) NRG NOI attests 'necessary environmental permits and water rights'

Independent estimate 2028-Q2 reflects the base-rate slip of a project with no visible mobilization 29 mo before reported COD, offset by strong developer + institutional TEF pathway + brownfield expansion (no greenfield permitting/land assembly overhead)
